response.sql: WITH dept AS (SELECT m.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM income i JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.department), shares AS (SELECT department, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM dept) AS share FROM dept), avg_s AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - avg_s.a) AS average_excess FROM shares s, avg_s WHERE s.share > avg_s.a
